La Novena Noche

Winter Ale

Toasted · Welcoming · Warm

ABV
6.6%
IBU
20
Color
Deep amber

A smooth, malt-forward winter ale inspired by Las Posadas and the nine nights of journey, welcome, and gathering.

Toasted Maris Otter, Munich, and Vienna malts lead the way, with piloncillo bringing a gentle brown-sugar depth. Orange peel and Ceylon cinnamon brighten the edges, while a small touch of smoked malt hangs in the distance like firewood on a cold night.

Rich, inviting, and made for open doors, warm lights, and good company.

For the walk. For the welcome. For the ninth night.
